gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-traditional-: Technical and bold, Nulshock stretches its unshaded outlines wide across the line. Yet Noto Traditional Nushu brings a broad-nibbed, approachable stroke whose bowls fill out the line, and that softness is the pair's best trick.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-numans: Nulshock draws everything as stretched, spaced-out outline. Numans counters with a plain sans whose s hangs its ends far from the spine, and its tracking is pushed well past normal, so the two share a wide, breathing stance.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-onest: Onest keeps its ascenders short above big bowls, with a gentle, uniform line thickness. Next to Nulshock's stretched, bold outline it feels friendly and contemporary.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-orienta: Nulshock looks like sign-shop vinyl cut to one line width. Orienta sits below with hollow-reed counters and little height difference between cases, so the pair's strongest quality is a steady, modern flatness.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-oxygen: Nulshock is stretched and bold, with zero stroke modulation. Oxygen does the quieter job, letting its curves stay open and its lowercase run nearly level with the capitals, so one font announces while the other simply carries on.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans uses one stroke thickness throughout, and its wide-mouthed letters stay crisp when shrunk. And Nulshock's stretched, spacious outline above it adds a technical, bold edge to the page.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-pathway-extreme: Pathway Extreme has stubby ascenders and descenders tucked beside a big x-height. Under Nulshock's heavy-tailed headings, a longer passage would read in a compact, open sans-serif texture that feels modern and clean.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear opens each letter mouth like a pried oyster shell and lifts its x-height high, a contemporary sans. Nulshock's rope-thin outline above it has no thick or thin parts, which makes the two sit well together.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-pt-sans-caption: Wide, rigid outline lettering up top, with horizontal bars exactly as heavy as the stems. And PT Sans Caption follows with big-bodied lowercase and bowls that feel unclosed and inviting, softening what Nulshock stretches out.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-puritan: Stretched outline, bold and technical. Puritan follows in a rounded sans-serif with oversized e and a counters, so a longer passage would feel approachable and clean after Nulshock's constant stroke width.
